title: Verify: Admin auth middleware and config unit tests
summary: httptest middleware cases and config default tests
description: Cover missing, wrong, empty and correct credentials plus config defaults.
acceptance_criteria: Missing/wrong/empty-token cases return 401 and next is not called
Config defaults and env override asserted
technical_constraints: httptest.NewRecorder; config via LoadFS with fstest.MapFS and fake getenv

steps.action: Table test with token "s3cret": no header -> 401; "Bearer wrong" -> 401; "Basic s3cret" -> 401; "Bearer s3cret" -> 200; Middleware("") with "Bearer " -> 401; assert a flag set by next is false for 401 cases

Load a MapFS config with only auth.token_secret; assert Round.Duration==24h, BaseRelease=="1.0.0", SchedulerInterval==30s; with getenv returning "tok" for STORYFORGE_ADMIN_TOKEN assert Admin.Token=="tok"
steps.expected: Config defaults test passes (go test reports PASS)
